blockingFindings: Review-run preflight failures after trace creation (context construction, canonical-base lookup, or evidence-sequence validation) bypass structured JSONL failure and terminal events, leaving only an incomplete start trace and plain stderr.
The launcher does not visibly enforce the prompt-level invariant that a pass decision must have an empty blockingFindings array; the supplied schema permits this inconsistent result to persist.
missingNegativeTests: Preflight review failure must emit exactly one structured failed terminal event.
A pass assessment with non-empty blockingFindings must be rejected before persistence.

architectureAssessment.deepModules: Routing, context, parsing, cancellation, and persistence helpers are separated, but the launcher remains a broad bounded coordinator.
architectureAssessment.hexagonalArchitecture: The local Codex process and repository evidence boundaries remain explicit; no provider or production authority is widened.
architectureAssessment.eventedBoundaries: Post-launch progress and cancellation events are structured and redacted, but preflight failures bypass the event boundary.

exactNextAction: Repair the bounded review-runner failure path and enforce the pass/blockingFindings invariant, then rerun the packet-required checks and request fresh semantic review on the new committed head.
